name: roopik-mcp-stdio-server
description: Roopik MCP STDIO Server - Bridges external AI agents to Roopik IDE

scripts.build:binary:win: npm run sync-schemas && npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs -t node22-win-x64 -o ../../../resources/mcp-binaries/roopik-mcp-win-x64.exe
scripts.build:binary:mac-x64: npm run sync-schemas && npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs -t node22-macos-x64 -o ../../../resources/mcp-binaries/roopik-mcp-macos-x64
scripts.build:binary:mac-arm64: npm run sync-schemas && npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs -t node22-macos-arm64 -o ../../../resources/mcp-binaries/roopik-mcp-macos-arm64
scripts.build:binary:linux: npm run sync-schemas && npm run bundle && pkg dist/bundle.cjs -t node22-linux-x64 -o ../../../resources/mcp-binaries/roopik-mcp-linux-x64
scripts.build:binaries: npm run sync-schemas && npm run bundle && npm run build:binary:win && npm run build:binary:mac-x64 && npm run build:binary:mac-arm64 && npm run build:binary:linux
